notes.title: Patch notes for V 1.0.4 Aug 07, 2020
notes.content:
[b]V 1.0.4 Aug 07, 2020[/b]

Balance Changes:

- Decreased the amount of Sharpened Arrows and Reinforced Walls Enemy Relics from most Elite Battles
- Decreased the amount of Swordsman-type enemies in mid-tier Normal and Elite Battles (Replaced them with Militia-type enemies)
- Tweaked some Enemy Army composition to reduce the combinations which have several Strong AOE Enemy Units (Melee or Ranged)

[b]Dev Note:[/b] We are decreasing the overall strength level of the Enemy Army around and during the 2nd Elite Battle on each Sector, as the highest difficulty spike we analyzed occurred there.

- Decreased the overall enemy spawn rate in Boss Battles very slightly
- Changed Boss Battle Maps into Huge category maps

[b]Dev Note: [/b]Boss Battles also appeared to be one of the highest spikes in difficulty. We don’t want to nerf the Boss too much, so we’re reducing the Enemy spawn rate in Boss Battle while changing the Boss map into Huge category map so Enemies (Boss included) should take longer to reach the player’s Portal

- Decreased the overall Attack strength of Al’Noobi Venomspitter

[b]Dev Note: [/b]Al’Noobi Venomspitters were dealing too much damage between their fast attack speed and their armor-ignoring poison. We are decreasing their base attack strength to let the poison do most of the work.

- Decreased the Unit threshold before Book of Silencing Sand Enemy Relic to activate from 10 to 6

[b]Dev Note:[/b] We are giving more control and counterplay opportunity for player against this Sector 2 Silencing Relic

- Decreased the amount of Horn of Battle Enemy Relic in Survival Battles with Militia Handbook Enemy Relic

[b]Dev Note: [/b]We saw Militia Handbook inflated the difficulty in Survival Battles, especially when combined with stacked Horn of Battle. We’re not nerfing Militia Handbook because it performed fine in Destroy Battles. Instead we are decreasing the stacking combinations of Horn of Battle to give the player more breathing room and plan their counter play against the Handbook.

Other Changes:

- Fixed unit pathfinding issue which causes some unit to get stuck in the middle of a path
- Fixed Perk Icon for Quickening Overload and Strength In Numbers

notes.title: We got some big ol updates in V 1.0.2 of Necronator: Dead Wrong
notes.content:
[b]V 1.0.2 Aug 05, 2020[/b]

Hello Chubat’s Chosen

Like the winged purple wonder we’re always watching and listening to feedback. Thanks for all your support so far, our main goal is that you have fun scourging the lands of Livmore.

[i]Now onto the updates![/i]

[b]Feature and Balance Changes/Improvements:[/b]

- Added new Player Relics: Pumpkin, Spirit Spaulders, Spirit Cutlass, Cleric's Robe, Catalogue, Flask of Clarity

[b]Dev Note:[/b] We’re adding some Mana related Relics to further increase variety in playstyle and deckbuilding

- Player can now hover on Relics in battle to see their progress or status (Such as the number of units, amount of cards played, etc)

[b]Dev Note:[/b] We considered some UI systems to show the Relic status/progress. We decided on enhancing the Relic Tooltip because it is the cleanest and one of the more accessible ways to preview the Relic status/progress.

- Added counters for current units and the dead amount for both player and enemy

[b]Dev Note: [/b]In addition to the Relic tooltip information, we are adding this UI so the player can easily monitor some Relics which are triggered based on the number of units and dead units

- Changed some Maps by making the first signpost closer to the player’s portal, reducing enemy funnelling towards your Portal.

[b]Dev Note: [/b]There will be more occurrences where enemies will approach your portal from 2 different lanes. This is implemented to reduce enemy clumping up and reaching critical mass of units, thus overwhelming the player in front of the portal. We will keep improving our map balance as this requires more time.

- Decreased the HP of Snowfall units by a bit
- Decreased the HP of Summoner units by a bit
- Decreased the overall spawn rate of Strong Ranged Units and Summoner Units
- Destroy Battles:
  - Increases initial reinforcements timer from 240s to 300s
  - Increases the intensity of the first enemy reinforcement
  - The second reinforcement will now be the final big wave of enemies, instead of the third.

[b]Dev Note: [/b]We are constantly monitoring analytical data regarding difficulty progression and considering multiple approaches to better tweak the game. From the feedback we received, there are some spike in difficulties but we are still pinpointing 

- Survive Battles:
  - Decreases Survive Mission time duration from 240s to 180s
  - Added additional Horn of Battle enemy relic to Survive Mission to compensate the decreased timer

[b]Dev Note:[/b] We are decreasing the time duration to decrease the amount of “dragginess” and increase the intensity of “Survive” battles. To compensate for this, we are slightly increasing the spawn rate of enemies to better portray the survival nature of the battle.

[b]Other Changes: [/b]
- Camera Zoom is now saved between battles
- Mouse Camera control is disabled when the player is hovering over cards to prevent unwanted camera movement
- Fixed Achievement for reaching Commander level 10 not triggering properly
- Fixed Razorguard's head
- Fixed Tome of Demonic Ritual from not activating for the rest of the battle if you “break” the ritual once
- Increases readability of some texts in commander selection, including the commander's bio and scenario description
- The gem on the bottom of cards and relics should properly show their rarity now
- Added new art for The Cavalry's Here
- Fixed Al'Noobi Battle Headgear Enemy Relic from triggering too often
- Removed 3 stacks of Divine Barrier from Boss Battles, they don’t really need them…

If you need to convince your friends to join in the celebration, you can let them watch our masterclass on how to be the greatest necronator.

[previewyoutube=0MxKqtDAuc4;full][/previewyoutube]

- New Enemy Units
- New Maps
- New Enemy and Boss Relics

Other changes:
- Added new effects when a card is Silenced, player has a small amount of time before it is fully Silenced
- Tweaked Gemmed Boots: Whenever 10 Player Units die, give Enemy Units +5 Armor and +100% Move Speed for 8s

  - Editor features including:
  - Choose to make a Campaign or Endless scenario
  - Modify sectors and choose Biomes and Bosses to appear

The whole [url=https://twitter.com/togeproductions]Toge Productions[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/modernwolfltd]Modern Wolf[/url] teams thank you for your help during those 6 months and we hope to see more people joining our necromancers rank.

[*]Added Enemy Relics: Hero Shield Shard: Increases Enemy HP by 20% per Level
[*]Added Enemy Relics: Champion Horn Shard: Enemies spawn faster per Level
[*][i]Developer's Comment: Each time the players beat a Sector, all of the Enemy Relics will gain a Level, increasing their effectiveness. Currently this system is only used for the Endless mode to increase the difficulty of Combat every time players complete a sector, but we will expand its usage in the future.

[/i]

[*]New Card Type: Status Effect: These are harmful cards with “While in Hand” effects, players can play them to remove their effects temporarily.
[*]New Status Effect Cards: Injury, Demotivated, and Drained

[*]Increased Commander’s Max Level to 10
[*]Added a new Starting Deck at Commander level 10
[*]New Spell Cards: Finger of Death, Mark of the Titans, Rust to Rust

As you can see, your feedback is hugely important to us; we implement more of it with every update. So please keep your comments and feedback coming on the Steam forums and in [url=https://discord.gg/toge]Toge's Discord[/url].
